No timely extension or earlier terminating provision is located in the held bounded EO search/chain. The six-month interim report is a performance deadline rather than an automatic end. EO:13316 later formally revokes the order effective September 30, 2003; that later revocation is not the first end.

savings.reason: Read all seven sections, especially section 5 support, staff, travel and FACA delegation, and section 7 termination, together with EO:13316 sections 3(g) and 6. The mission, principles, reporting and agency support are all Commission-dependent. No independent continuing command, transfer or express savings provision was found. Ordinary accrued travel expenses or compensation under existing law do not continue Commission authority. Bounded EO/eCFR searches disclosed no surviving or revived mandate.

research_rationale: The complete original (67 FR 22337–22338) section 7 terminates the Commission one year from the date of the order unless the President extends it before that date. The printed date is April 29, 2002; the exact anniversary is April 29, 2003, without month-end ambiguity. Read all original sections and full EO:13316 actor context, including section 3(g) and section 6. No earlier automatic ending is provided: the six-month interim-report direction in section 6(a) is not an end, while the final-report date is set by the Chair/President and does not trigger termination. All other commands organize, direct, fund or support this Commission; none creates a program surviving its end. The supplied chain and missing list contain no extension lead; a mere reservation of presidential extension power does not prove an actual extension. Accept the fixed-term result provisionally after the bounded searches, subject to independent review and any actual contrary extension evidence. EO:13316 revokes the named order effective September 30, 2003, later than its own-terms expiry. The actor machine label Sec. 2 and partial-scope metadata are erroneous for this target: section 3(g) names the entire order, and section 6 supplies effectiveness. Original-source inventory overrides retain every complete section and every internal command. OFR catalog disposition and saved-order searches cover this 2002 order and later changes; the selected eCFR/CFR search checks regulatory references through October 14, 2026. The USC release stops October 9 and is not selected. The searches are bounded rather than proof of all possible presidential communications; nothing held affirmatively indicates a non-EO extension. Provisional no status remains unchanged.

review_notes.search_coverage: Selected OFR search: 6,938 post-1937 catalog records and operative sentences in 7,619 saved EO texts; three hits for this order. Selected eCFR/CFR search: point-in-time 2026-10-14 and 49 CFR title files, two hits; no current-law leads supplied and no conflicting continuing mandate in dossier. No material conflict or missing lead is listed. Non-EO presidential communications are outside these scopes; the conditional extension language alone is not affirmative extension evidence. USC search not selected because its release has a five-day cutoff gap.
